From [Lionel PENDLEBURY.]

To Dr. FINKELSTEIN, 13, Shelford Park, Great Shelford.

Date of Letter 13.6.35.

Date of Postmark -

SUMMARY OF CONTENTS

Writes to cancel letter of previous day as he has to travel for an interview to-morrow. Will come on Saturday.

For translation see attached sheet.

COMMENT

(a) No action required. P.A.

(b) See Minute ( )

Initials
